Uses of Package
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.mfa

Packages that use com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.mfa
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.mfa
Use cases of the multi-factor framework: security events, second-factor lockout and trusted devices.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott
Use cases of the one-time-code (e-mail and SMS) authentication factor: requesting, verifying and cleaning up codes, and the policy beans they share.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.passkeys
Use cases that manage the passkeys (WebAuthn credentials) of a user: list, rename and delete, whether the user has one (a second factor enrolment query), and the relying party settings.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms
Use cases of the SMS channel: phone enrolment and verification, cost-capped sending of codes and the enrolment query of the SMS second factor.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.social
Use cases of social login (identity brokering): resolving a sign-in with an external provider to an account (finding it, linking by verified e-mail address, or provisioning it), linking, unlinking and listing the identities of an account.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.totp
Use cases of the TOTP authenticator-app second factor and its recovery codes.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.x509
Use cases of X.509 client certificate sign-in: resolving a certificate fingerprint to an account, binding a certificate to an account and unbinding it.

    Class
    Description
    CreatedTrustedDevice
    A trusted device just created, with the signed cookie value that is only available now.
    HasConfirmedSecondFactorUseCase
    Use case that tells whether a user has confirmed any second factor, asking every SecondFactorEnrolmentQuery bean.
    MfaProperties
    Multi-factor settings, bound once from authserver.mfa.* and injected wherever one of them is needed (the use cases of this module and the step-up guard of the API).
    RecordSecurityEventUseCase
    Use case that records a security event (login, second factor, lockout, trusted device) in the audit log.
    SecondFactorEnrolmentQuery
    Extension point that tells whether a user has confirmed one kind of second factor.
    TrustedDeviceTokens
    Creates the random tokens that identify a trusted device and hashes them, so only the SHA-256 hash is ever stored.

    Class
    Description
    CheckSecondFactorLockoutUseCase
    Use case that tells whether the second factor of a user is locked after too many failed attempts.
    RecordSecurityEventUseCase
    Use case that records a security event (login, second factor, lockout, trusted device) in the audit log.
    RegisterSecondFactorFailureUseCase
    Use case that counts a failed second-factor attempt and locks the second factor of the user once authserver.mfa.max-failed-attempts consecutive failures are reached.
    ResetSecondFactorFailuresUseCase
    Use case that clears the failed second-factor attempts of a user, after a successful verification.
